# AWS Student Builder Group (AWS SBG)

> Official student-led cloud computing community affiliated with and supported by Amazon Web Services (AWS).

AWS Student Builder Group (AWS SBG) is a global, student-led community program powered by Amazon Web Services (AWS) across 60+ countries. The group empowers students, developers, and aspiring cloud architects to explore cloud computing, build real-world software, and accelerate tech careers.

## Core Pillars & Activities
- **AWS Study Jams & Workshops:** Hands-on technical sessions covering EC2, S3, Lambda, Serverless, Containers, and Generative AI on AWS.
- **Certification Preparation:** Structured study paths and exam vouchers for AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and AWS Certified Solutions Architect.
- **Hackathons & Build Challenges:** Collaborative builder sprints solving real-world challenges using AWS cloud infrastructure.
- **Career & Mentorship:** Direct connections to AWS Community Heroes, Campus Leaders, and industry cloud architects.
